exports.notes: Refresh the reviewed LOC FDD source contribution and persist approved LOC sustainability criterion claims. Existing DPC, NARA, PRONOM, LOC crosswalk, and approved LOC-PRONOM bridge contributions are reused from MongoDB.

criterion_mapping.notes: Apply only the approved LOC FDD mapping. LOC supplies source-native evidence for the seven sustainability factors; no overall LOC risk score is created. Documentation is retained as supporting Disclosure evidence, not an eighth top-level factor.

sources.notes: Reviewed LOC FDD projection. The production source structure exposes only LOC's seven official sustainability factors at native_fields.sustainability_factors; Documentation is retained under native_fields.sustainability_factor_details.disclosure.documentation. PUID/QID strings found in XML prose remain contextual only.
